segments.t: 周二傍晚的前台，汉娜在阿瑟和伊芙琳面前铺开了米色卡纸和一支黑笔。先完整听一遍吧。
Look at our small wooden sign for the street gate: short, warm, and easy to read.
Read it aloud for me, Hannah, so I hear how a neighbor hears it.
'Room Nine Garden Cafe: Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart and Tea. Open Daily.'
And underneath in smaller letters: 'Friday Piano Tea at Six O'Clock.'
My aunt's exact Friday hour right on the gate! That makes me proud.
I also wrote the four prices clearly in big numbers so nobody has to squint.
Even without glasses I can read those numbers from two meters away!
Did you leave a small basket by the door for neighborhood book sharing?
Right beside the piano: all those clean travel books from the hallway bookcase!
A public cafe, a neighborhood reading corner, and live music: every word of the city rule!
Let me go practice the waltz once through while Tessa bakes the tart shells.
I will carry these menu cards into the kitchen and check on Tessa!
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段满怀希望的对话。
Look at our small wooden sign for the street gate: short, warm, and easy to read.
「看看我们给临街大门做的小木牌：简短、温馨，而且通俗易懂。」 在表示容易、困难或简单的形容词之后，英语直接使用主动形式的不定式：
easy to read
就像中文的“容易读”一样简洁明了。
Read it aloud for me, Hannah, so I hear how a neighbor hears it.
「大声念给我听听，汉娜，让我听听街坊邻居听起来是什么感觉。」 由古老的词缀 a- 加上 loud 组成的副词
Read it aloud
明确表示要“出声地”读出来，而不是在心里默念。
'Room Nine Garden Cafe: Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart and Tea. Open Daily.'
「“九号房间花园咖啡馆：新鲜热汤、刚出炉的面包、柠檬挞和茶。每天营业。”」 在英语的商店橱窗和商业招牌上，仅仅两个词就足以宣告营业时间：
Open Daily
这里的 open 永远是形容词，不用加 -ed 结尾。
And underneath in smaller letters: 'Friday Piano Tea at Six O'Clock.'
「在下面还有一行小字：“周五六点钟钢琴茶歇。”」 作为一个方位副词直接使用，后面不需要再跟宾语：
And underneath
简明扼要地指示出下一行字在招牌的下方。
My aunt's exact Friday hour right on the gate! That makes me proud.
「我姑妈当年雷打不动的周五时光，就挂在大门上！这让我感到很自豪。」 想要表达“让某人感到自豪或高兴”，英语采用直截了当的结构
That makes me proud
动词 make 后面紧跟人称代词，再接上形容词。
I also wrote the four prices clearly in big numbers so nobody has to squint.
「我还用大号数字把四个价格写得很清楚，这样谁都不用眯着眼睛看了。」 这是一个非常形象、专用于视觉的动词：
has to squint
准确地描绘了为了看清太小的字而眯起眼睛的动作。
Even without glasses I can read those numbers from two meters away!
「就算不戴眼镜，我在两米开外都能看清那些数字！」 在说明从多远的距离看或听时，英语会把距离放在 from 和 away 之间：
from two meters away
表示在两米之外的距离。
Did you leave a small basket by the door for neighborhood book sharing?
「你在门边放了一个小篮子作为社区图书共享角吗？」 三个名词或名词形式从左到右连在一起：
neighborhood book sharing
最后的核心词 sharing 承载了“共享”这个核心概念。
Right beside the piano: all those clean travel books from the hallway bookcase!
「就在钢琴旁边：全是从走廊书柜里拿出来的那些干净的游记！」 千万别把 public library 里的公共图书馆，和走廊里这种用来放书的家具搞混了，这叫
the hallway bookcase
字面意思就是走廊里的书柜或书架。
A public cafe, a neighborhood reading corner, and live music: every word of the city rule!
「一个对公众开放的咖啡馆、一个社区阅读角，还有现场音乐：市政规定的每一条都做到了！」 发音细节要注意了：这个带有双元音 /laɪv/ 的形容词
live music
虽然拼写和动词“生活”一样，但在这里读作 /laɪv/，专门表示音乐或节目的“现场直播”或“现场演奏”。
Let me go practice the waltz once through while Tessa bakes the tart shells.
「让我去把那首圆舞曲从头到尾练一遍，趁泰莎在烤蛋挞皮的时候。」 在表示次数的短语后面加上 through，例如
once through
特指把一首曲子完整地从头到尾弹奏一遍。而 tart shells 就是指烤好备用的挞皮。
I will carry these menu cards into the kitchen and check on Tessa!
「我要把这些菜单卡片拿到厨房去，顺便看看泰莎那边怎么样了！」 在介词 on 后面跟上人名：
check on Tessa
意思是带着关切的心情去看看某人状况如何。现在，用自然语速把整个场景再听一遍吧。
Look at our small wooden sign for the street gate: short, warm, and easy to read.
Read it aloud for me, Hannah, so I hear how a neighbor hears it.
'Room Nine Garden Cafe: Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart and Tea. Open Daily.'
And underneath in smaller letters: 'Friday Piano Tea at Six O'Clock.'
My aunt's exact Friday hour right on the gate! That makes me proud.
I also wrote the four prices clearly in big numbers so nobody has to squint.
Even without glasses I can read those numbers from two meters away!
Did you leave a small basket by the door for neighborhood book sharing?
Right beside the piano: all those clean travel books from the hallway bookcase!
A public cafe, a neighborhood reading corner, and live music: every word of the city rule!
Let me go practice the waltz once through while Tessa bakes the tart shells.
I will carry these menu cards into the kitchen and check on Tessa!
清晰的菜单、共享的书籍、周五的钢琴时光，每一项关于传承的承诺都在逐渐成真。我们下个场景厨房见。
See you soon!
